name: Isaac
summary: A consumer home robot from San Francisco's Weave Robotics: two arms with parallel grippers on a wheeled base that telescopes from about 0.9 m to 1.7 m, wrapped in soft fabric with a cartoon face. It runs household chores autonomously and falls back to remote human teleoperation when stuck; the Isaac 1 is priced at US$7,999.

sources.title: Weave Robotics launches Isaac, its first mobile humanoid robot — The Robot Report
